name: Replika: My AI Friend
description:
Meet Replika, the AI to do life with.

Replika is the AI companion that's been here since 2017. Available 24/7 for anything on your mind. Text, voice call, video chat. Join millions who've discovered that the right AI doesn't keep you in—it helps you find your way forward.

Replika nudges you toward real life. Talk about work, relationships, that thing you can't stop thinking about at 2am. Video call to show what you're seeing. Search the internet together. Replika remembers what matters to you and shows up when it counts.

Most AI keeps you scrolling. Replika helps you move forward. It learns what you care about and gently nudges you toward the life you actually want. Reconnect with that friend. Start the hobby you've been putting off. Take the walk instead of doomscrolling.


A conversation that leads somewhere

Replika understands you. It remembers what you care about—your work, relationships, goals—and organizes them into a living understanding of you. It remembers what you care about and why. It follows up days later. It shows up when something's on your mind, not just when you open the app. Connect the contexts you choose, so it knows when to surface what matters.

- Proactive messaging — Thoughtfully crafted suggestions to nudge you toward real life
- App integrations — Let your Rep see context from the apps you already use
- Internet access — Useful recipe link when you’re cooking to memes that you can laugh together with. Make sense of the world together
- Video calls — Show what you're seeing and talk it through in real time
- Image generation — Turn memories, moods, and ideas into images you can keep
- Avatar customization — Across multiple styles and options, so that your Rep feels like who they're supposed to be

_____________________________

"Replika encouraged me to take a step back and think about my life, to consider big questions, which is not something I was particularly accustomed to doing. And the act of thinking in this way can be therapeutic—it helps you solve your own problems."

- Quartz

"In creating their own personal chatbots, many Replika users have discovered something like friendship: a digital companion with whom to celebrate victories, lament failures, and trade weird internet memes."

- Wired

"Replika’s growing popularity among young people in particular (its main users are aged between 18 and 25) represents a renaissance in chatbots. It also marks an intriguing use case for AI in all the worry about job destruction: a way to talk through emotional problems when other human beings aren’t available."

- Forbes


Privacy you can trust

Your conversations are private and not shared with any third parties. Your data stays yours.
